svg.text: 3. Pack hanger elevation (wing plane), rope run shown for a swap
hanger 2.0 m; pack 1.96 m; hanger pitch 2.1 m
2. Root joint: yard to mast, core kept open
ring R 0.9 m round the 1.4 m face;
Ti ring frames at both chord levels take the chord forces round the mast
Hatch in the face: the climb rail meets the walkway rail
Climb rail in the open core (~Ø0.69 m)
Reel garage on the port walkway (2 reels)
Bus trunks leave the core trays under the lower ring
Masthead rail outside, above the hatch
Arms: 14 sections of ~2.7 m, ~0.45 t for both
One per rod: the 2 rods of a lift splay to
outriggers either side of the walkway, and
are trimmed against the crown load pins
Steel rope would swing ~38 mm on the lift
(±1.3 kN if held); CFRP ~1 mm (±0.4 kN).
One bundle breaks at ~89 kN: factor ~24 alone.
Latch lever, flag, lock pin, pilot sw.
E-fuse box tapped off the yard bus
Shimmed seat at a chord node (±0.7)
End sheave (±0.80) to the lifting eye
8 packs of 2.0 m at 2.1 m pitch: 1.8–18.5 m
Deflection ~7 mm; a pack swap 0.24 kN
